title: The sharp radius lies between zero and one
statement: For real $q$ and $\lambda$, define $u=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$ and $\rho(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(u/q)/\sinh(u/(q/(q-1)))}$, using the usual real operations on the stated parameter range. If $q>2$ and $0<\lambda<1/2$, then $0<\rho(q,\lambda)<1$.
